messages:
julia: FYI PR #3490 adds a new 'Rate limits & quota' how-to with Node/Go SDK snippets. I noticed the Node snippet references /sdk/node/rate-limits (old v1) — that will break for customers. Can someone fix before merge? :grimacing:
ben: Good catch. I can update the snippet to the new package path `@redwood/inference` and the updated call signature.
chloe: Also we should include an example showing `X-Rate-Limit-Remaining` handling and a small backoff pseudo-code. Lots of users ask how to surface quota headers.
julia: Agreed. Add a one-paragraph note explaining short vs long windows and how burst credits affect headers. Maybe a tiny table explaining `limit`, `remaining`, and `reset` fields.
docs-bot: Preview build 3490 is ready: https://deploy-preview.redwood-inference/3490 (status: failed linkcheck) :warning:
ben: Proposed Node snippet (inline):``
js
import Redwood from '@redwood/inference';
const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_KEY });
const res = await client.rateLimits.get({ window: 'minute' });
console.log('remaining', res.headers['x-rate-limit-remaining']);
```
chloe: For Go snippet:``
go
client := redwood.NewClient(os.Getenv("REDWOOD_KEY"))
resp, err := client.GetRateLimits(context.Background(), redwood.RateLimitParams{Window: "minute"})
if err != nil { /* handle */ }
fmt.Println(resp.Headers.Get("X-Rate-Limit-Remaining"))
```
julia: Nice. Two quick asks: 1) Add a note under examples that dashboard panel name is `billing_quota_usage` so integrators can map metrics. 2) Replace broken `/sdk/node/rate-limits` link with `/sdk/node/metrics/rate-limits` and create a redirect from the old URL.
infra-bot: Redirect ticket created: RDR-512 (old /sdk/node/rate-limits -> /sdk/node/metrics/rate-limits). Ops assigned.
ben: I'll also add a tiny test in docs/tests/snippets_rate_limit_test.py asserting that snippet exposes headers in a dict: `assert 'x-rate-limit-remaining' in headers`. That should catch regressions.
chloe: Editorial: change title to sentence case "Rate limits and quota" and add a short note about timezone not affecting token windows (server side).
docs-bot: CI: linkcheck fixed on branch docs/ratequota-fix (build 3490.2). snippets test queued. :white_check_mark:
julia: Assigning @chloe and @ben as reviewers. If all good, merge before EOD to include in weekly docs release.
ben: Merged after approvals. I'll follow up with a small changelog entry.
